\textbf{\texttt{score\_formula\_match}} \\
\begin{description}
    \item[\textbf{Description:}] Binary score: 1.0 if match, 0.0 if not
    \item[\textbf{Arguments:}]
    \begin{description}

        \item \texttt{ground\_truth} (required)
    \end{description}
\end{description} \\

\textbf{\texttt{score\_isotopic\_distribution}} \\
\begin{description}
    \item[\textbf{Description:}] Score the isotopic distribution of a molecule based on the provided prediction and ground truth.
    prediction: list of element symbols (e.g. ["C", "H", "O"])
    ground\_truth: SMILES string
    \item[\textbf{Arguments:}]
    \begin{description}
        \item \texttt{prediction} (required)
        \item \texttt{ground\_truth} (required)
    \end{description}
\end{description} \\
\midrule
\textbf{\texttt{score\_molecule}} \\
\begin{description}
    \item[\textbf{Description:}] Compare predicted and ground truth SMILES strings and calculate similarity score.
    Stereochemistry is not considered in the comparison.
    \item[\textbf{Arguments:}]
    \begin{description}
        \item \texttt{prediction} (str) (required): SMILES string of predicted molecule
        \item \texttt{ground\_truth} (str) (required): SMILES string of ground truth molecule
    \end{description}
    \item[\textbf{Returns:}] float: Score between 0.0 and 1.0 based on similarity
\end{description} \\
\midrule
\textbf{\texttt{score\_molecule\_fragments}} \\
\begin{description}
    \item[\textbf{Description:}] Score the prediction based on whether fragments are substructures of the ground truth molecule.

    This function handles charged fragments by neutralizing them before substructure matching.
    Fragments with extreme charges (|charge| > 1) that create unrealistic neutral structures
    are treated more leniently to account for fragmentation artifacts.
    \item[\textbf{Arguments:}]
    \begin{description}
        \item \texttt{prediction} (list) (required): List of SMILES strings representing fragments.
        \item \texttt{ground\_truth} (str) (required): SMILES string of the ground truth molecule.
    \end{description}
    \item[\textbf{Returns:}] float: Score between 0.0 and 1.0 based on fragment matching.
               Returns 1.0 if a high percentage of reasonable fragments match.
\end{description} \\
\midrule
\textbf{\texttt{score\_num\_aromatic\_carbons}} \\
\begin{description}
    \item[\textbf{Description:}] Count aromatic carbons in the molecule, this is centers on cyclic,
    planar molecules with a specific number of delocalized pi electrons,
    exhibiting enhanced stability due to resonance.
    \item[\textbf{Arguments:}]
    \begin{description}
        \item \texttt{prediction} (required)
        \item \texttt{ground\_truth} (required)
    \end{description}
\end{description} \\
